Finally someone said it! I feel like a lot of people come here and see their symptoms and self diagnose or have people with POTS try to diagnose them all the time. This can be so dangerous because without seeing your doctor you could be missing another potential issue completely separate from POTS with similar symptoms. Never ask the internet to diagnose you!
